question.problem:
Simplify $\operatorname{tanh}⁡(2q)$ in terms of $e$ using the definition of the hyperbolic tangent.

$\operatorname{tanh}⁡(2q)=$

| {{field-1}} |
| --- |
| ${e}^{4q}+1$ |
question.worked_solution:
The definition of $\operatorname{tanh}⁡x$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡x & =\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}-1}{{e}^{2x}+1} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-2x}}{1+{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the second definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡(2q) & =\frac{{e}^{2(2q)}-1}{{e}^{2(2q)}+1} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{4q}-1}{{e}^{4q}+1}\,\,.\end{aligned}
$$
